column1: # Producer matrix — the single source of truth for "which unit delivers where".
#   unit     systemd unit name; the matching systemd/<unit> must exist in this repo
#   route    route key; must be present in bin/buzz_routes.env
#   payload  file    — an artifact is attached and must be anchored to the invocation
#            status  — proposal-or-decline receipt, one short line
#            summary — completion summary composed by the caller
#   status   wired   — the unit source carries DELIVERY_ROUTE and a delivery hook
#            pending — not yet ported; the unit source must carry NEITHER
# The expected-fire calendar is NOT duplicated here — audit_buzz_dual_run.sh derives it
# from each unit's own systemd/<stem>.timer OnCalendar, so the two cannot drift.
# scorecard.service was silent and unrouted before this migration. Decision (2026-08-04):
# it joins `ops`. It is a weekly rollup of agent-run outcomes — the same operational feed
# as the morning report — and a rollup nobody reads is a rollup that stops being written.
